svg.aria-label: How folder rules file one chat. The chat, Marmot meetup, has 6 people including you, unread messages and no draft. A chat moved by hand stays in that folder and skips the rules; Follow folder rules in the move dialog hands it back. Otherwise the folders are checked in order. Folder 1, Work, matches all of its rules: name includes standup fails and fewer than 10 people holds, so Work does not match. Folder 2, Busy, matches any one rule: more than 5 people holds and has a draft fails, so the chat files under Busy. Folder 3, Friends, comes later in order and is not checked. Unfiled takes a chat when no folder matches.

g.text: Moved by hand, it stays in
that folder and skips the rules.
